Intraday इंट्राडे

Trades opened and closed within the same trading session. Positions must be squared off before the market closes.

हिंदी में: इंट्राडे

एक ही ट्रेडिंग सत्र में खुले और बंद होने वाले ट्रेड। बाज़ार बंद होने से पहले पोज़िशन बंद करनी होती है।

How it is used in the lessons

Intraday (usually called MIS): you buy and sell within the same day.

From Stock Market Foundations

Intraday trading opens and closes positions within the same trading session.

From Intraday Trading

Business or professional income: profit from trading as a business activity, such as frequent intraday trading, speculative trading, or F&O.
